title: Compliment
description: Give genuine praise to build rapport.

title: Whisper
description: Share private intel to gain trust.

title: Watch Room
description: Watch the Hub without approaching anyone.

title: Group Chat
description: Mingle with the Hub. Build broad goodwill.

title: Heart-to-Heart
description: Step away from the noise and deepen a genuine one-to-one bond.

title: Open Up
description: Share something personal and give this relationship room to become real.

title: Read the Room
description: Watch the Hub dynamics without discussing nominations or pushing a target.

title: Propose Personal Pact
description: Ask this hubmate for a private two-person protection pact.

title: Consult Alliance
description: Ask your official alliance for a read on the decision in front of you.
availabilityHint: Select a member of one of your active alliances

title: Offer Protection
description: Promise to use your vote or power to protect a vulnerable player when you can.

title: Betray Ally
description: Turn against an ally for personal gain while remaining in the pact.

title: Reassure
description: Offer emotional support. Builds trust and goodwill.

title: Clear the Air
description: Own a mistake and sincerely repair tension with this player.

title: Share Intel
description: Trade your intelligence for social leverage. Converts info into influence.

title: Spread Rumor
description: Plant a damaging rumor about a player.

title: Start Fight
description: Escalate tension. Risky — may backfire.

title: Confront
description: Directly challenge someone's behavior or motives.

title: Request Favour
description: Call in a favour from your network.

title: Pitch Target
description: Suggest to the LOH who they should nominate.
availabilityHint: Talk to LOH about a target

title: Suggest Replacement
description: Pitch a replacement nominee to the POS holder or LOH.

title: Ask to Use Safety
description: Ask the POS holder to use safety on a nominee.
availabilityHint: Talk to POS about a nominee

title: Ask Safety Plan
description: Ask the Safety holder what they intend to do. They may be honest or stay vague.
availabilityHint: Available while Safety is still undecided

title: Respect Nominations
description: As LOH, ask the Safety holder not to use Safety and leave your nominations unchanged.
availabilityHint: LOH only, before Safety is used

title: Warn About Danger
description: Tell this hubmate the LOH named them as a target. They may appreciate it, but the LOH could find out.
availabilityHint: Requires target intel from the LOH

title: Why Betray Me?
description: Privately ask why this hubmate turned against you.

title: Ask Why You Were Nominated
description: Press the LOH for a candid explanation of why they put you at risk.

title: Ask LOH Target
description: Ask the LOH who they currently want out, including a possible backup plan.
availabilityHint: Ask the current LOH about their plan

title: Ask for Nomination Advice
description: As LOH, ask who they would nominate. They may be candid, evasive, strategic, or offer themself as a conditional pawn.

title: Ask About a Player
description: Ask a houseguest how they really feel about someone else in the Hub.

title: Warn About Player
description: Warn an ally about a player you find suspicious.

title: Rally Votes Against
description: Rally a voter to eliminate a specific nominee.

title: Test the Spark
description: Explore a possible romantic connection.

title: Flirt in Private
description: Nudge a growing spark away from the group.

title: Late-Night Talk
description: Open up when the rest of the Hub is asleep.

title: Cuddle
description: Share a close private moment under the blankets.

title: Secret Kiss
description: Risk a kiss where another hubmate might notice.

title: Pool Makeout
description: Turn the chemistry up with very little cover.

title: Spend the Night
description: Choose intimacy over subtlety and accept the risk.

title: Try for a Baby
description: Make a consensual, life-changing decision with your romantic partner.

title: Ask for Pregnancy Test
description: Ask the pregnancy carrier to take a test. The action opens the day after an attempt; early tests are inconclusive.

title: Take Pregnancy Test
description: Take your own pregnancy test. It opens the day after an attempt; early tests are inconclusive.

title: Share Pregnancy News
description: Tell selected hubmates privately. Their loyalty affects the chance they keep your news secret.

title: Take Paternity Test
description: Privately establish paternity after an ambiguous pregnancy becomes public.

title: Go Public
description: Stop hiding the romance and face the strategic fallout.

title: End It
description: Break off the relationship before the game does it for you.

title: Break the Alliance
description: Dissolve this strategic alliance and accept the fallout it leaves behind.

title: Snoop Around
description: Look for private deals, hidden chemistry, or loose receipts.

title: Make a Pact
description: Turn a close friendship into a ride-or-die bond.

title: Risk the Vibe
description: See whether a ride-or-die friendship is becoming something more.

title: End the Ride-or-Die
description: End this personal ride-or-die bond; it does not dissolve a separate alliance.

title: Plant a Lie
description: Tell one hubmate a calculated lie about another.

title: Trade Secrets
description: Automatically exchange one fresh lead each way when available.

title: Eavesdrop
description: Listen for a circulating story without joining in.

title: Expose a Secret
description: Take a known story public. A false claim can ruin credibility.

title: Pit Them Against
description: Use existing tension to push two hubmates apart.

title: Call Them Out
description: Turn private conflict into a public confrontation.

title: Private Truce
description: De-escalate a rivalry or repair a damaged alliance.

title: Form Alliance
description: Propose a formal alliance with another player.

title: Nominate Player
description: Strategically name a target for elimination.

title: Vote Rally
description: Rally votes using your influence. High influence required.

title: Lay Low
description: Keep to yourself and make no social move.
